Why Modal? The app has to wake up every hour and make many Grok calls. Then it has to store the results and serve them on a page. A laptop script stops when the lid closes, and your own server sits idle most of the day. On Modal, the collection is a scheduled function, so there's nothing to keep running. Dot map runs the xAI calls in parallel across containers. A Modal Volume stores each run, and a Modal Secret holds the xAI key. A web endpoint serves the page at a public URL. And between runs it scales to zero, so you only pay for the seconds it works.

take: This is a job-market pulse. Every hour it samples tech posts on X, sorts them into hiring, layoffs and looking for work, and counts the roles, companies and skills they mention. You get your own up-to-date numbers, instead of waiting for a monthly report.

This is a job-market pulse. Every hour it samples tech posts on X, sorts them into hiring, layoffs and looking for work, and counts the roles, companies and skills they mention. You get your own up-to-date numbers, instead of waiting for a monthly report.
0001a.png

Why Modal? The app has to wake up every hour and make many Grok calls. Then it has to store the results and serve them on a page. A laptop script stops when the lid closes, and your own server sits idle most of the day. On Modal, the collection is a scheduled function, so there's nothing to keep running. Dot map runs the xAI calls in parallel across containers. A Modal Volume stores each run, and a Modal Secret holds the xAI key. A web endpoint serves the page at a public URL. And between runs it scales to zero, so you only pay for the seconds it works.
